kb.title: Refund policy
kb.body: Returns: items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. The customer chooses whether the refund goes to the original payment method or to store credit. Partial refunds by item and quantity are allowed.

kb.title: Price adjustments
kb.body: If an item's price on shopright.com drops after purchase, customers can request a price adjustment within 7 days of delivery.
